scripts.start: AGENTS=2 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) npm run network
scripts.network: hc s clean && npm run build:happ:opt && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run launch:happ"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive && RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=info cargo test --release --manifest-path ./tests/Cargo.toml -- --test-threads=1
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:cli
scripts.start:tauri: AGENTS=2 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) npm run network:tauri
scripts.network:tauri: hc s clean && npm run build:happ:opt && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run launch:tauri"
scripts.launch:tauri: concurrently "kitsune2-bootstrap-srv --listen 127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT" "echo pass | RUST_LOG=warn hc launch --piped -n $AGENTS workdir/checked.happ --ui-port $UI_PORT network --bootstrap http://127.0.0.1:"$BOOTSTRAP_PORT" webrtc ws://127.0.0.1:"$BOOTSTRAP_PORT""
scripts.package: npm run build:happ:opt && npm run package -w ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:happ:opt: npm run build:zomes && find ./target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/*.wasm | xargs -I '{}' wasm-opt '{}' -O2 --output '{}' && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:zomes: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.lint: npm run -w ui lint && cargo clippy && cargo clippy --manifest-path ./checked_cli/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path ./tests/Cargo.toml
scripts.format: npm run -w ui format && cargo fmt && cargo fmt --manifest-path ./checked_cli/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path ./tests/Cargo.toml
